absolute_performance_gate.metric: overall validation-split BER from frozen receiver evaluations
absolute_performance_gate.reason: Reject candidates whose established overall BER is meaningfully worse, even if raw confidence scales make their per-frame margin look high.
absolute_performance_gate.source_note: Computed as the mean of 135 per-frame validation BER values per receiver from experiments/reliability_detector/train_validation_features.csv. Test labels are not used to configure the controller gate.
